name: protect-story-metadata-from-gitignore-data-loss
title: Protect tracked story metadata from .gitignore data-loss and resolve the track/ignore contradiction
description: Bug 3 (most serious) from the 2026-06-15 ClawCreek bug report (Lattice 0.3.5). Story metadata under .lattice/story/actives/* must be git-tracked (it holds index.json/background.md/checklist.json/decision.json/plan.md), but the worktree bootstrap runs `git add .lattice/story/actives/<id>` WITHOUT -f (worktree.ts:316). This creates a contradiction: if a user gitignores .lattice/ (to protect it from git clean) the bootstrap fails with 'paths are ignored'; if they do NOT carefully craft a negation allowlist, the metadata stays untracked and a routine git clean -fd / git checkout permanently deletes it with no git-history recovery (ClawCreek lost 19 stories' files this way). This repo (Orchestrate) is currently safe ONLY because .gitignore hand-crafts the ignore-volatile/track-metadata allowlist (.gitignore:9-18); the framework never scaffolds or validates this, so fresh projects default into the data-loss trap. Outcome: story metadata is reliably protected — pick ONE coherent model (force-add + check-ignore validation/guard at bootstrap; OR scaffold/validate the .gitignore allowlist on init; OR relocate volatile runtime out of the tracked metadata prefix) and make bootstrap + protection consistent. Scope: track/ignore model + data-loss protection only; not gitRoot cwd (B-2856) or bootstrap atomicity (Bug 2).
